_comment: Optional: copy to config/local.json only to change something. Every root defaults to the standard macOS location (src/dwarfstar/paths.py: assets ~/AI/DwarfStar, data ~/Library/Application Support/DwarfStar, cache ~/Library/Caches/DwarfStar, logs ~/Library/Logs/DwarfStar). Set assets_root, data_root, cache_root or logs_root here (or DWARFSTAR_ASSETS/_DATA/_CACHE/_LOGS) only to move one. A second checkout must use its own data, cache and logs roots, never the installed ones.
